item_short_desc: Show off your American spirit with Rothco's 'Murica US Flag T-Shirt, a rugged and comfortable option designed for an athletic fit. This tee features a bold black American flag graphic with 'MURICA proudly printed beneath. Its tailored design includes a slightly smaller chest, armhole, and sleeve opening for a more streamlined, athletic silhouette. Crafted from a soft yet durable blend of 60% cotton and 40% polyester, the shirt offers a perfect balance of comfort and longevity.
description: Show off your American spirit with Rothco's 'Murica US Flag T-Shirt, a rugged and comfortable option designed for an athletic fit. This tee features a bold black American flag graphic with 'MURICA proudly printed beneath. Its tailored design includes a slightly smaller chest, armhole, and sleeve opening for a more streamlined, athletic silhouette. Crafted from a soft yet durable blend of 60% cotton and 40% polyester, the shirt offers a perfect balance of comfort and longevity. The insert collar adds a sleek touch, while the tag-less label ensures itch-free comfort for all-day wear. Whether you're heading out for a casual day or celebrating your love for the USA, this tee makes a statement with its bold design and comfortable fit.
